about.title: About Me
about.tagline: I build native iOS apps, tinker with data and statistics, and teach robots to solve mazes.
blurbs: Technical Cofounder of Just Pray — a production iOS app on the App Store, built with SwiftUI in a team of 4.
3rd-year Computer Systems & AI student at INSA Rouen-Normandie, with hands-on experience in Python, embedded systems, and machine learning.
Multilingual — I speak English, French, Arabic, Spanish, and German.

featured.label: Featured
featured.name: Just Pray — Muslim Prayer Habit Tracker
featured.description: A production iOS app live on the App Store that helps Muslims build consistent prayer habits through tracking, reminders, and streaks. As Technical Cofounder, I architect and develop the entire frontend in SwiftUI, leveraging Apple's native APIs — Widgets, Live Activities, Screen Time, and Alarms — to deliver a deeply integrated iOS experience. Built in a team of 4, iterating on user feedback.

items.name: Auto-Decomposer
items.description: Breaks down audio into recognizable patterns using FFT frequency analysis, then reproduces them with spectral similarity scoring.

items.name: Robot-Car
items.description: An autonomous maze-solving robot running on Raspberry Pi with multi-sensor integration and servo motor control.

items.name: MecSimCalc 2.0 — Grand Prize
